prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Keep Up portfolio case-study scene
Input images: Image 1 is the user-approved style and composition reference; Image 2 is the approved material and line-system quality board; Image 3 is the approved hero craft benchmark.
Primary request: Create an original early sound-era rubber-hose animation cel scene of a cheerful anthropomorphic pocket quiz-card character running forward with buoyant momentum. The character carries a tiny blank calendar and streak motif, while two simple angle-bracket code symbols bounce alongside like small companions. The action should communicate daily programming practice, recall, and steady progress without using text or interface screenshots.
Scene/backdrop: minimal paper-white track with a few looping motion lines, tiny stepping-stone tiles, and soft gray abstract tech-city silhouettes in the distance.
Style/medium: black-and-white early sound-era rubber-hose animation cel; ink black on warm paper white; soft gray wash; subtle cel grain and faint paper wear; confident uniform smooth contour; boneless hose limbs; circular joints; white gloves; pie-cut eyes; rhythmic squash and stretch. Match the visual grammar and production quality of the three references without copying their characters, brands, layouts, or lettering.
Composition/framing: exact 5:4 landscape composition intended for 1000 by 800 pixels. Full character visible in an energetic three-quarter run, centered slightly left, with the small blank calendar and symbolic angle brackets clearly readable as motifs. Keep all limbs and props comfortably inside the crop and preserve negative space around the silhouette.
Lighting/mood: cheerful, brisk, encouraging, clever, habit-forming.
Color palette: monochrome ink black, paper white, wash gray, soft gray, charcoal only.
Materials/textures: cardstock quiz card, inked cel, soft paper grain, sparing dry-brush wash.
Constraints: no words, no letters, no numerals, no score, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no readable interface text, no branded marks. Calendar squares must be blank. Angle brackets are allowed only as abstract code punctuation. No color, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D render, no humans.
